bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the Finance Manager Salary in Sydney

When you search for a **finance manager salary Sydney**, you’ll find figures from recruitment surveys and industry reports. However, the most reliable benchmarks come from the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) and the Fair Work Ombudsman. The ABS’s May 2026 release shows full-time adult average weekly ordinary time earnings of $2,083.70. That’s a national average across all occupations, but it gives a useful starting point. For a 38‑hour week, that annualises to about $108,352.

Keep in mind that actual finance manager salaries depend on your experience, the size of the organisation, and whether you’re covered by an award or enterprise agreement. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides [pay guides](/blog) for many awards, but there is no single award that covers all finance managers. If your role is award‑free, your minimum pay is the National Minimum Wage: $26.44 per hour or $1,004.90 per week from 1 July 2026. Most finance managers earn well above that.

## How to Convert an Hourly Rate to an Annual Salary

The core formula is simple: hourly rate × hours per week × 52. We assume a standard full‑time week of 38 hours, as used by the Fair Work Ombudsman and the ABS. For example, if your hourly rate is $55.00:

- Weekly pay: $55.00 × 38 = $2,090.00
- Fortnightly pay: $2,090.00 × 2 = $4,180.00
- Annual gross: $55.00 × 38 × 52 = $108,680

This calculation assumes you work the same hours every week, with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, or allowances. It’s a base estimate. You can use [the timesheet](/) to enter your own hourly rate and see the annual figure instantly.

### Why 38 Hours?

The 38‑hour week is the standard full‑time benchmark under the National Employment Standards. Many awards and agreements use it. If you work more or fewer hours, adjust the formula accordingly. For part‑time or casual roles, the weekly hours may differ.

## Tax and Medicare on Your Annual Salary

Once you have your annual gross figure, you can estimate your take‑home pay using the 2026–27 resident tax rates:

- $0 – $18,200: nil
- $18,201 – $45,000: 15¢ for each $1 over $18,200
- $45,001 – $135,000: $4,020 plus 30¢ for each $1 over $45,000
- $135,001 – $190,000: $31,020 plus 37¢ for each $1 over $135,000
- $190,001+: $51,370 plus 45¢ for each $1 over $190,000

Add the Medicare levy, generally 2% of your taxable income. (The 2025–26 single reduction thresholds are used here because the 2026–27 thresholds were not confirmed at the time of this guide.) For a $108,680 salary:

- Tax: $4,020 + 0.30 × ($108,680 – $45,000) = $4,020 + $19,104 = $23,124
- Medicare: 0.02 × $108,680 = $2,173.60
- Total deductions: $25,297.60
- Estimated take‑home: $83,382.40 per year, or about $1,603.50 per week

Visit our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) page for a more detailed calculator that includes HELP repayments and the Medicare levy surcharge.

## Superannuation: Paid on Top

Superannuation is an extra contribution your employer makes, not a deduction from your salary. From 1 July 2026, the super guarantee rate is 12% of your ordinary time earnings, paid at the same time as your wages (Payday Super). The maximum earnings base for super is $270,830 per year.

For a $108,680 salary, your employer would add $13,041.60 in super each year. This goes into your nominated super fund and is taxed at 15% inside the fund. It does not affect your take‑home pay. Learn more on our [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) page.

## Casual Loading and Other Considerations

If you work as a casual finance manager, you may be entitled to a 25% casual loading on top of the base hourly rate. The National Minimum Wage for casuals is $33.05 per hour (including loading) from 1 July 2026. On [the timesheet](/) you can check a box to add 25% casual loading to your base rate. Never enter a rate that already includes loading; the tool handles it automatically.

Award rates may also include penalty rates for weekend or evening work. The Fair Work Ombudsman’s [pay guides](/blog) list these for each award. If you’re covered by an enterprise agreement, those rates override the award.

## Using the ABS and Fair Work Data for Your Finance Manager Salary Sydney Search

When you look up “finance manager salary Sydney”, you’ll see many numbers. The most authoritative sources are:

- **Fair Work Ombudsman**: sets minimum wages and award rates. The National Minimum Wage is $26.44/hour; award minimums increased by 4.75% from 1 July 2026.
- **Australian Bureau of Statistics**: publishes Average Weekly Earnings. The May 2026 figure for full‑time adult ordinary time earnings is $2,083.70 per week.
- **Australian Taxation Office**: provides tax tables and super guarantee rules.

Recruiter surveys often report higher figures because they include bonuses and benefits. Use them as a guide, but rely on the official sources for your baseline calculations.

## Summary

To estimate a finance manager salary in Sydney, start with an hourly rate, multiply by 38 hours and 52 weeks. Apply the 2026–27 tax scale and 2% Medicare levy. Add 12% super on top. Use our [reference tables](/data) for quick conversions, and always check the [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) page for updates. The [average pay](/topics/average-pay) page has more ABS data. Remember, this is an estimate—your actual pay depends on your specific employment conditions.
